description:
Find any folder on your PC in seconds from the terminal (Spanish interface).

fast-folder-cli finds folders by name with a concurrent disk walk, ignoring case and accents.
It lists your projects (Git, Node.js, Python, Go, .NET...), filters by modification date,
shows folder sizes and has an arrow-key interactive mode. The fcd command changes into the
chosen folder, and an Explorer context menu entry opens the search in any folder.
The interface is in Spanish.
